description: An envelope built by accumulation: each ping adds a fixed voltage to what the envelope is already at, and between pings it bleeds away

params.text: Sets how much voltage each ping adds, 0 to 10V
Sets how long each ping's addition takes to arrive, 1ms to 2 seconds
Sets how long the envelope takes to bleed back to 0V, 10ms to 10 seconds
Blends the rise and fall between a constant rate and a rate proportional to what is left, from a tight shape at one end of the travel to a soft one at the other

inputs.text: A rise queues another addition of the delta voltage
A rise drops the envelope straight to 0V and clears every addition that has not finished arriving
Changes how much each ping adds, scaled by a tenth and added to the delta knob, the total clamped to the knob's travel
Changes the rise time, scaled by a tenth and added to the rise knob, the total clamped to the knob's travel
Changes the fall time, scaled by a tenth and added to the fall knob, the total clamped to the knob's travel
Changes the curve, scaled by a tenth and added to the curve knob, the total clamped to the knob's travel

outputs.text: The envelope, 0-10V, scaled so that additions near the ceiling count for less and the voltage approaches 10V rather than hitting it

notes: the envelope moves only when it is pinged: with nothing patched at PING the output holds at 0V
the fall is held off while an addition is arriving, so a ping always reaches its full delta before the bleed starts again
up to thirty-two additions can be in flight at once; beyond that the oldest is written over

bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
